description: This file defines the AnnualCompoundingPeriod class, which implements the CompoundingPeriod interface to calculate interest for a savings account based on annual compounding. It manages a list of end-of-day balances within a given interval and provides methods to compute interest using various methods like daily balance and average daily balance, accommodating different interest calculation types and compounding periods.

classes.name: AnnualCompoundingPeriod
classes.description: Represents a period for annual interest compounding, providing interest calculation methods based on balances and different interest calculation strategies.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of AnnualCompoundingPeriod within a specified date interval with given balances.

methods.name: calculateInterest
methods.description: Calculates interest based on the given interest calculation type and period parameters.

methods.name: calculateUsingAverageDailyBalanceMethod
methods.description: Calculates interest using the average daily balance of the end-of-day balances.

methods.name: calculateUsingDailyBalanceMethod
methods.description: Calculates interest on individual daily balances according to the specified compounding period type.

methods.name: endOfDayBalancesWithinPeriodInterval
methods.description: Filters the list of end-of-day balances to include only those within the specified period interval.

methods.name: getPeriodInterval
methods.description: Returns the date interval representing this compounding period.
